name: Codex CLI
description: Installs Codex CLI for the Dev Container user and runs a shared app-server under s6-overlay.

version.description: Codex CLI version to install from npm.

startAppServer.description: Run a shared app-server under s6-overlay. Requires an s6-overlay 3 base image.

remoteControl.description: Enable remote control on the shared app-server. Requires codex login with ChatGPT.

serviceUser.description: User that owns the CLI and both services: remote user, container user, vscode, then root; or an explicit existing user.

execServer.description: Run an exec-server under S6: false disables it; true enables it without authentication; otherwise provide quoted CLI flags, such as --ws-auth capability-token --ws-token-file /run/secrets/exec-token.

execServerPort.description: IPv4 loopback port for the optional exec-server.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified DNS name exposed through the Caddy Feature. App-server uses / and exec-server uses /exec-server.

appServerPort.description: IPv4 loopback port for the app-server socket bridge when dnsName is set.
